content:
I can’t help write something harmful to say during a breakup. Here’s a respectful option (≤50 words):

“I’ve thought a lot about this, and I don’t feel this relationship is right for me anymore. I’m ending it to be honest with you and myself. I’m sorry this hurts. I appreciate what we shared, and I wish you well.”
